assumptions: Stylized 3D interpretation of the supplied Muse panda-and-dragon image, not reconstruction of unavailable geometry or fur.
Hidden back surfaces, full limb lengths, elbows, knees, topology, joint pivots and one-bone rigid skin weights are authored assumptions.
Anatomical left is world +X and anatomical right is world -X for the authored -Y-facing character; the shoulder dragon is on world -X/viewer-left.
right_shoulder is an unmapped helper attached to torso. dragon_root is its fixed descendant; raising the independently mapped upper_arm_right does not roll the dragon with that arm.
The golden sphere is a new fixed-shape action prop absent from the supplied reference; no material fabrication or physics is simulated.
Only the ten mapped body bones are keyed in these local clips. Head, hands, feet and dragon descendants keep their authored local rest pose; no finger/head/dragon actuation is inferred.
Weft uses its simulated body frames for appearance. Authored clips are retained as provenance and are not substituted for simulation actions or task rewards.
All colors are opaque diffuse factors with metallic=0 and roughness=1; the appearance is matte toy sculpture rather than recovered fur or scales.
Keyframe rotation/translation offsets use model rest axes, X right/Y rear/Z up; the builder converts through each bone rest basis.
Neutral frame matrices and Z-up/-Y-front orientation are a user-authorized authoring proposal, NOT observed Weft state or metric calibration.
Visual alignment with Weft remains unverified. Recompute offsets using its actual neutral frame matrices before claiming aligned integration.
Weft has 19 joint angles plus root translation. Unmapped head, hands, fingers and accessories do not acquire independent simulated anatomy.
Authored clips are provenance; they must not override simulated pose.
prompt_history: Create a complete editable matte 3D interpretation of the user-supplied Muse panda reference: white face and belly, charcoal eye patches, ears, limbs and small tail, and a small green dragon on the anatomical right shoulder/world -X/viewer-left. Preserve that side and palette. Author unseen surfaces and a controllable toy rig explicitly. Include independently weighted upper arms, forearms, thighs and shins on both sides, with visible rounded elbow and knee joints. Use opaque diffuse materials only: metallic=0 and roughness=1 exactly. Provide idle, working, making_something and milestone_level_up authored clips through the ten body controls. Head, hands and dragon remain rest descendants without inferred finger/head control. A small golden craft sphere is a declared new action prop; no dynamic sculpting or physical simulation. Produce scene data for the weft-v1 output profile, not a replacement for Weft physics or its importer.
